    next(h["url"] for h in batch_hits[0] if "Chapter 4" in h["title"]),
    next(h["url"] for h in batch_hits[0] if "SP 330 - Section 2" in h["title"])
]

evidence = dict(zip([single_url] + batch_urls, [single_text] + batch_texts))
print("Fetched lengths:", {url: len(text) for url, text in evidence.items()})
print("Cached fetch matches:", cached_text == single_text)
print("Fetch failures:", [url for url, text in evidence.items() if "FETCH_FAILED" in text[:100]])
print("Budget:", budget())

        check_constraint(
            row=f"/rows/{i}", constraint=f"columns/{j}", verdict=True,
            url=cell["sources"][0], quote=cell["quote"]
        )

        row=f"/rows/{i}", constraint="question", verdict=True,
        url=unit_url, quote=expected_quote
    )
